propositions: Jira-family-general units (identity convention, probe classifier, field sanitizers, link vocabulary) are currently mixed into the Cloud adapter, violating the ADR 0035 seam by enabling unsanctioned cross-package private imports

The relocation must preserve observable behavior across J1's characterization oracles unmodified, with a single declared behavior change: deleted status now maps to Done instead of the invalid Deleted

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) cannot move; shared logic is achieved through dependency inversion where pinned modules import from jira_family rather than the reverse

The value-map literals currently exist in two drifting copies (jira_fields.py and outbound_fields.py); the extraction must consolidate to a single authoritative source in jira_family with both ACLI and backend importing from it

New imports into location-pinned modules must use absolute paths, never relative, because those modules are loaded via spec_from_file_location under synthetic package contexts where relative imports fail
Every importer and mock.patch target targeting moved symbols must be re-pointed in the same change with no re-export shims left behind
